page.overview:
Who is Lady Jaye?

Lady Jaye is a character in the G.I. Joe: Renegades cartoon series.

Lady Jaye is a member of Flint's Falcons squad. She goes most everywhere with him. She also has a soft spot for Duke and the Joes and often does minor things to help them escape Flint.
